programme.title: Dogs: The Untold Story: Wild Survivors
programme.desc: Traveling the globe to explore the characteristics that make a wild dog wild, discover how their past has shaped your pet and learn the differences between your dog at home and its wild relatives.

programme.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins: Robert & the Rattlesnakes
programme.desc: Robert wrangles western diamondback rattlesnakes in Arizona for the first time, learning techniques passed down by his dad Terri helps save some of the hospital's tiniest patients, three baby feathertail gliders Bindi chats with Occa the cockatoo.

programme.title: I Was Prey: Feeding Frenzy
programme.desc: Andrea Schlake volunteers at an animal sanctuary when a chimpanzee escapes its enclosure and chases her down a great white shark knocks surfer Todd Endris off his board and attacks him.

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R.
programme.desc: After seeing the disappearance of wildlife in northern Africa, Ivan joins an elite capture team to see how wildlife is captured, bought and sold wildlife trade is a ground breaking business model.

programme.title: Lair of the Great White
programme.desc: A team of experts attempts to find out why a population of great whites off the coast of Western Australia is so much more aggressive than others the team braves the elements and ventures into treacherous underwater caves to find out for themselves.

programme.title: Treetop Cat Rescue: Top Cats
programme.desc: Tom is called out to Olympia on a late night rescue mission neighborhood dog chases large indoor cat, Earl, high up on a tree and doesn't exactly let Tom rescue him Play-Play needs rescuing in La Conner.

programme.title: The Zoo
programme.desc: A gorilla must undergo a critical root canal to fix its tooth problem a red-crested turaco chick fledges the nest a pair of puma cubs travel to their new home at the Queens Zoo.

programme.title: Bear vs. Shark
programme.desc: Putting his wits and survival skills to the test, adventurer Bear Grylls faces off with the ocean's apex predator he goes chumming from a helicopter, diving into a feeding frenzy and posing as human bait.

programme.title: The Zoo
programme.sub-title: A Sea Lion Pup Grows Up
programme.desc: Zoo staff face unexpected setbacks weaning a bright sea lion pup off its mother's milk the bird team steps in to support a rejected curassow chick a squirrel monkey visits the dentist.
